rowB.text: Audience views: policy maker vs battery trader

qA1.text: Open question: is the scenario the top-level switch (every page re-renders for S0…S4), or is scenario comparison its own page? Mock assumes top-level switch plus a compare mode on the overview.

qA2.text: Open question: third axis? Add policy outcomes (bill, peak, emissions once solar exists) as rows next to the five value channels, or keep them only in the policy view.

qA3.text: Only S0 has data. S1–S4 tiles are drawn in their 'not run' state on purpose: the page should make missing scenarios obvious, never blank or zero.

qB1.text: Open question: heatmap cell = mean paired effect, with hatching when the 95% CI crosses zero. Or show CI width as cell size? Hatching is easier to read.

qB2.text: Trader view needs the revenue-by-channel split. Today it is 100% within-day spread by construction. The split only becomes informative from S1 (carry-over) and S3 (solar).

qB3.text: Replace 'cycles/day' with full-power hours as the headline. Real S0 range is 0.9–5.1 h/day; the 0.6-cycle flag goes.

qC1.text: Week strip needs multi-day episodes (S1). Bid-curve inspector works from existing data: dispatch.npz already stores bids and offered quantities per hour.

qC2.text: Health page gates the rest: if learned / achievable is below some threshold for a config, should its tiles elsewhere show a warning chip? Proposal: yes, below 80%.
